standard.source: 区画線の設置様式について (MLIT, 1974-12-26) https://www.mlit.go.jp/road/sign/kijyun/pdf/19741226kukakusenn.pdf
standard.note: Line width and the 5 m dash and gap are the urban standard values. Stop bars, zebra stripes and diamonds follow common practice and are estimates, not checked against the order's annexed drawings.

note: Street View panoramas viewed as reference only, nothing downloaded. Each profile records one or two sampled points on the corridor, not a survey of its whole length; the width-class defaults apply to every road without a named profile.
